known_text: I'm sorry but I'm too busy today.
target_text: 对不起，但是我今天太忙了。

use.known: I'm sorry I don't have time to help you today.
use.target: 对不起，我今天没有时间帮你。

use.known: She said she is sorry for being so busy lately.
use.target: 她说她对不起最近这么忙。

use.known: I'm sorry I couldn't answer your question earlier.
use.target: 对不起，我之前不能回答你的问题。

use.known: He told me he is very sorry about what happened.
use.target: 他告诉我他对发生的事很对不起。

use.known: I'm sorry we cannot come to that place with you.
use.target: 对不起，我们不能和你一起去那个地方。

use.known: She is sorry she was too busy to call you yesterday.
use.target: 她对不起她昨天太忙了没给你打电话。

use.known: I like this idea, but I don't have time right now.
use.target: 我喜欢这个主意，但是我现在没有时间。

use.known: She wants to come tomorrow, but she is too busy.
use.target: 她想明天来，但是她太忙了。

use.known: He told me the idea is good, but we need more time.
use.target: 他告诉我主意很好，但是我们需要更多时间。

use.known: I'm sorry, but I don't mind at all if you go.
use.target: 对不起，但是如果你去的话我一点都不介意。

use.known: Everyone wanted to help, but they were all too busy.
use.target: 大家都想帮忙，但是他们都太忙了。

use.known: I know what you said, but I have a question.
use.target: 我知道你说的，但是我有一个问题。

use.known: I'm sorry but I have too many questions to ask.
use.target: 对不起，但是我有太多问题要问。

use.known: I really want to help you but I am too busy now.
use.target: 我真的想帮你，但是我现在太忙了。

use.known: I hope you don't mind but I need more time.
use.target: 我希望你不介意，但是我需要更多时间。

use.known: I told her I'm sorry but I cannot come tomorrow.
use.target: 我告诉她我对不起，但是我明天不能来。

use.known: I think this is a good idea but I have concerns.
use.target: 我觉得这是一个好主意，但是我有担忧。

use.known: I don't mind at all but I need to ask you something.
use.target: 我一点都不介意，但是我需要问你一些事。

use.known: I'm sorry but I am too busy to help you today.
use.target: 对不起，但是我今天太忙了，不能帮你。

use.known: She told me she doesn't have time to talk today.
use.target: 她告诉我她今天没有时间聊天。

use.known: Everyone is very busy at that place today.
use.target: 今天那个地方的人都很忙。

use.known: I don't mind at all if we meet tomorrow instead of today.
use.target: 如果我们明天见面而不是今天，我一点都不介意。

use.known: He asked me if I could help him with something today.
use.target: 他问我今天能不能帮他做一个事。

use.known: I'm sorry, but today I really don't have any time.
use.target: 对不起，但是我今天真的没有时间。

use.known: I'm sorry but I'm too busy to help you today.
use.target: 对不起，但是我今天太忙了，不能帮你。

use.known: She said the question was too difficult to answer.
use.target: 她说那个问题太难回答了。

use.known: He told me he was too tired to come here yesterday.
use.target: 他告诉我他昨天太累了不能来这里。

use.known: This is too important for us to ignore.
use.target: 这个对我们来说太重要了，不能忽视。

use.known: I'm sorry but this is too much for me to do alone.
use.target: 对不起，但是这个太多了，我一个人做不了。

use.known: Everyone thought the time was too short to finish.
use.target: 大家都觉得时间太短了，做不完。

use.known: I'm sorry but I'm too busy today to help.
use.target: 对不起，但是我今天太忙了，不能帮忙。

use.known: She said everyone at that place is very busy now.
use.target: 她说那个地方的人现在都很忙。

use.known: He's too busy this evening but can come tomorrow.
use.target: 他今天晚上太忙了，但是明天可以来。

use.known: I don't mind at all if you're too busy to call.
use.target: 如果你太忙不能打电话，我一点都不介意。

use.known: Everyone has been very busy with work this week.
use.target: 这个星期大家工作都很忙。

use.known: I'm sorry, but I'll be busy all day tomorrow too.
use.target: 对不起，但是我明天一整天也会很忙。

use.known: I finished this work but now I'm too tired.
use.target: 我做完了这个工作，但是现在太累了。

use.known: She told me she already knows about this problem.
use.target: 她告诉我她已经知道这个问题了。

use.known: He became too busy to help us after that day.
use.target: 那天之后他变得太忙了不能帮我们。

use.known: I'm sorry but we already have other things to do.
use.target: 对不起，但是我们已经有别的事要做了。

use.known: Everyone knows about this problem now.
use.target: 现在大家都知道这个问题了。

use.known: I became too tired and couldn't finish the work today.
use.target: 我变得太累了，今天做不完那个工作。
